$comment: Hand-curated listings for parties that never appear on a ticketing API:
warehouse nights, afterhours, door-only shows, Instagram-only announcements.
Add an object to 'events' below and open a PR (or edit straight on GitHub).
The next scheduled refresh picks it up automatically -- these entries win
over platform listings when the same party appears in both.
Required: title, start, venue.  'start' is Vancouver local time,
ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-15T23:00:00. A 2am start is fine -- the site files
it under the night before, the way anyone going to it would.
Set "draft": true to keep an entry in the file without publishing it.

example.title: Basement Sessions 004
example.description: Deep house and disco until late.
